title: QA-开发 Bug 流程
html:
QA-开发 Bug 流程

概述

本章聚焦测试与开发之间的缺陷处理流程，分为 Bug 生命周期、Bug 描述规范、优先级与分类、QA-Dev 沟通四个部分。它提供缺陷流转各环节的英语词汇，重点是描述问题和沟通修复的准确说法。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合缺陷报告和团队沟通。建议把生命周期与描述规范结合起来学习，做到既报得清楚，又跟得顺畅。

Bug 生命周期

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
report v./n. 报告 bug report, report an issue
assign v. 分配 assign to developer, assigned owner
investigate v. 调查 investigate the cause, under investigation
fix v./n. 修复 apply a fix, bug fix
verify v. 验证 verify the fix, QA verification
close v. 关闭 close the ticket, mark as closed

听说例句

A: I've reported a new bug and assigned it to the backend team. B: Thanks. I'll investigate it today and push a fix by tomorrow. Can you verify once it's deployed?

A: The fix has been deployed to staging. B: I'll verify it now. If it passes, I'll close the ticket.

写作表达

  • The bug lifecycle follows a structured flow: report → assign → investigate → fix → verify → close.
  • QA verification after each fix ensures that the issue is fully resolved before the ticket is closed.

Bug 描述规范

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
steps to reproduce n. 复现步骤 list steps to reproduce, STR
expected behavior n. 预期行为 expected vs actual, expected result
actual behavior n. 实际行为 actual result, describe actual behavior
environment n. 环境 test environment, production environment
screenshot n. 截图 attach screenshot, provide screenshots
log n. 日志 error log, attach logs

听说例句

A: Your bug report is missing the steps to reproduce. B: Sorry, let me update it with the STR, expected vs actual behavior, and attach the error logs.

A: Which environment did you test on? B: Staging. I've attached screenshots and the relevant logs from the test environment.

写作表达

  • A well-written bug report includes clear steps to reproduce, expected and actual behavior, and supporting screenshots.
  • Attaching relevant logs and specifying the environment accelerates the investigation process.

优先级与分类

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
P0/P1/P2/P3 n. 优先级等级 P0 critical, P1 high priority
blocker n. 阻断问题 release blocker, mark as blocker
showstopper n. 致命问题 showstopper bug, potential showstopper
cosmetic adj. 外观的 cosmetic issue, cosmetic bug
functional adj. 功能性的 functional defect, functional regression
known issue n. 已知问题 document as known issue, known issue list

听说例句

A: Is this a P0 or P1? B: It's a P0 blocker — users can't log in. We need a showstopper fix before the release.

A: The button color is slightly off. B: That's a cosmetic issue, P3. Let's log it as a known issue and fix it in the next sprint.

写作表达

  • P0 blockers must be resolved before any release can proceed, as they represent showstopper-level defects.
  • Cosmetic issues are tracked as known issues and scheduled for resolution in subsequent maintenance sprints.

QA-Dev 沟通

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
reproduce v. 复现 unable to reproduce, consistently reproducible
root cause n. 根本原因 find root cause, root cause analysis
workaround n. 临时方案 suggest a workaround, temporary workaround
reopen v. 重新打开 reopen the ticket, issue reopened
regression n. 回归 regression introduced, regression test
ETA n. 预计完成时间 provide ETA, what's the ETA

听说例句

A: I can't reproduce this bug on my machine. B: Try the staging environment with the test account. If you still can't, let me provide a screen recording.

A: What's the ETA for the fix? B: I've found the root cause — it's a regression from last week's merge. ETA is end of day.

写作表达

  • When a bug cannot be reproduced, QA should provide additional context including environment details and screen recordings.
  • The root cause was identified as a regression introduced in the previous sprint, with an ETA of 24 hours for the fix.
